# Vendored front-end libraries

Pinned copies served from the binary, so the page needs no internet. MIT unless noted.

| File | Package | Version |
|---|---|---|
| xterm.min.js, xterm.min.css | @xterm/xterm | 5.5.0 |
| addon-fit.min.js | @xterm/addon-fit | 0.10.0 |
| marked.min.js | marked | 15.0.12 |
| mermaid.min.js | mermaid | 11.6.0 |
| purify.min.js | dompurify (Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0) | 3.4.16 |
| sqlite3.mjs, sqlite3.wasm | @sqlite.org/sqlite-wasm (Apache-2.0; SQLite itself is public domain) | 3.53.4-build2 |

Refresh with the URLs in `scripts/vendor-web.sh`.
